title: KNN Implementation Details Can Dramatically Change Performance: An Example from Cover Trees
abstract: arXiv:2610.16940v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Nearest neighbor search algorithms are widely used and have a long history, but we find that key implementation details are seldom reviewed in articles about them. These details can materially impact performance, and thus change the conclusions one makes about a given algorithm's superiority. In this article, we highlight these impacts by reviewing the Cover Tree as an example, producing RustKNN, a unified Rust implementation of three construction variants of the Cover Tree with three query modes. Our analysis reveals: (1) the optimal query strategy depends on $k$ and on the dataset (single-tree search is fastest at $k{=}1$ on three of our four largest datasets, while dual-tree search is fastest at $k{\ge}5$ on the three largest), and choosing the wrong query mode can cost up to a $7.5\times$ factor in runtime; (2) the cover tree base parameter, set to 2 in theory and 1.3 in practice, is not a safe default for dual-tree search: 1.3 is

translated_title: KNN实现细节可极大改变性能：以覆盖树为例
translated_abstract: 最近邻搜索算法应用广泛且历史悠久，但我们发现相关文章中很少审视其关键实现细节。这些细节会实质性影响性能，从而改变人们对某一算法优越性的判断结论。本文以覆盖树（Cover Tree）为例来凸显这些影响，开发了RustKNN——一个统一实现了覆盖树三种构建变体和三种查询模式的Rust实现。我们的分析揭示：(1) 最优查询策略取决于k值和数据集（在四个最大数据集中的三个上，单树搜索在k=1时最快；而在三个最大数据集上，双树搜索在k≥5时最快），选择错误的查询模式可能导致运行时间高达7.5倍的代价；(2) 覆盖树基参数（理论上设为2，实践中通常设为1.3）对于双树搜索而言并非安全的默认值……
tldr: 本文通过统一实现覆盖树三种构建变体与三种查询模式（RustKNN），揭示了KNN算法的实现细节——如查询模式选择和基参数设置——可导致高达7.5倍的性能差异，从而实质性改变关于算法优劣的结论。
en_tdlr: Using RustKNN, a unified Rust implementation of three Cover Tree construction variants with three query modes, this paper demonstrates that KNN implementation details—such as query strategy choice and base parameter settings—can cause runtime differences of up to 7.5×, fundamentally altering conclusions about algorithmic superiority.
